name: Price-up / tx-count-down divergence -> exhaustion fade short (BTC, transaction throughput)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the active-addresses variant: it reads THROUGHPUT — btc_tx_count — rather than unique participants; tx-count divergence catches settlement-demand exhaustion which can diverge from address counts, e.g. when a few whales transact but broad on-chain settlement dries up): a price pushing highs while btc_tx_count falls means the up-move is not backed by rising on-chain settlement demand — thin, derivative-led price. The fade harvests reversion when the chasing flow exhausts. Entry: RSI overbought AND tx_count low. Fade short; exit on RSI cooling or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1 (confound): tx_count also leaks to L2/batching -> if the decline is secular the signal is always-on; KILL if it is a one-way trend. DISCONFIRMER 2: if the active-addresses variant (10) and this give the same trades they are one spec — throughput must add distinct information over participant count. DISCONFIRMER 3: shorting into a trend can blow the DD cap; KILL if no forward predictive coefficient after BH-FDR. Very high death probability — a test. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: new price highs unconfirmed by on-chain transaction throughput
